explanation:
The central tree shrinks from 127 to 84 lines (33.9%) and from 8,345 to 6,009 characters (28.0%). Five peripheral trees expand meaningful concept nodes. Modular boundaries remain visible through public capabilities and private helpers; call sequences explain writes and reconstruction; ownership explains caches, queues and disposal; data dependencies explain reference maps and publication order.

Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: canvasCatalogStore.ts passes ALL catalog revision histories to sourceBindings, which reads each history's head, rather than only current representation revisions. WorkspaceRecordStore.read reads every manifest blob on a cache miss; history=current narrows validation, not disk reads. CanvasCatalogStore parses checkpoint requests before entering its serialization queue. Workspace mutation queues are module-local and keyed by root; catalog serialization is per instance, so cross-process exclusion is not established. The catalog's writeJsonAtomic implementation is not supplied, so its fsync behavior cannot be inferred from publishJson. DiagramRevisionStore explicitly lacks fsync calls.

Peripheral additions absent from the seed include reversible checkpoint diffs and identity-sensitive restore caching (canvasCheckpointRecords.ts), disposal responsibilities and replacement projection after worker restart (workspacePersistence.ts, recordStorage.ts, workspaceStorage.worker.ts), exact transfer-link conditions and index limits (workspaceRecords.ts), retention of all document archive references during selected-head publication (workspaceRecordStore.ts, canvasCatalogStore.ts), and cache limits/invalidation behavior (immutableRecords.ts, canvasCatalogStore.ts).

Only the point, pinned source text and seed supply evidence. Imported repository adapters, HTTP handlers, catalog write helpers and UI transaction callers are not supplied; their wiring or guarantees are not asserted. Acknowledgement-before-UI-installation is the stated RecordStorage contract, not verified caller behavior. No blob reclamation implementation is shown. Positions use measured text bounds with gaps; edges use 1-based raw lines.
